remarks: Welcome to 94  Siena, an inviting rarely available single level home in the Gated enclave of Siena in Marina Hills. Superb 3 bedroom 2.5 bath home is situated on an Ideal Corner Lot. Abundant light bathes this home main gathering rooms. Double entry doors greet you into the inviting open concept living room with vaulted ceilings, Well appointed kitchen with sunny breakfast nook, white cabinets, ample counter and storage space. The primary suite acts as your personal sanctuary, complete with floor to ceiling custom wood shutters, French doors that open directly to the manicured, artificial turf yard.
